sources.title: Guernsey Arts (Guernsey Arts Commission LBG): Guidance Notes For Arts Funding Applications (PDF dated 18 Dec 2025; linked from https://www.arts.gg/get-involved)
sources.said: Guernsey Arts will consider applications from individuals, non-commercial organisations and others who use the arts for the benefit of the community … The events must take place mainly in the Bailiwick … If you fall into one of the following categories, your application will not be considered. … Any commercial activity or project by an organisation or individual. … Projects that are essentially long-term day-to-day running costs. … Arts projects with no community element.

sources.title: Guernsey Arts: Get Involved
sources.said: Guernsey Arts and its funding committee distribute grants to support local arts in all its forms, from small community projects to major festival events.

figures.finding: Not researched today; A Crown Dependency with its own tax law, outside the UK credits; GG.json found only the statutory minimum wage as a pay floor. The island's only arts funder found excludes any commercial project, so a producer's series for sale has no public fund here. A search lead (not read) says Guernsey Arts has backed 11 film projects since 2021 and gives about GBP 59,000 a year, mostly under GBP 5,000.

value.eligible: individuals and non-commercial organisations, for work mainly in the Bailiwick with a community element
